Patient Priority Portal is the institution-grade DLT platform: permissioned network engineering (Fabric/Besu-class) with governance charters and legal wrappers, tokenization with securities-law discipline, smart contracts built to formal-verification standards, provenance networks for EUDR/DPP-grade traceability, and verifiable-credential ecosystems against eIDAS 2.0 expectations.

Ledger leads with governance because networks fail on governance, not cryptography: membership rules, data-visibility zones, key custody under HSM, and regulator packs — privacy model, audit exports, jurisdiction analysis — shipped with every network.

Ledger networks ship key management under HSM custody, timelocked upgrade governance, and immutable audit exports. Smart contracts carry specification, verification and independent audit before value moves; pause procedures are rehearsed, not improvised.
